name: unidpdf
expr: y_s = unidpdf(3, 6); y_v = unidpdf(ks, 6); y_lo = unidpdf(0, 6); y_hi = unidpdf(7, 6); y_frac = unidpdf(2.5, 6); y_n0 = unidpdf(3, 0); y_nneg = unidpdf(3, -1); y_nfrac = unidpdf(3, 6.5); y_nan = unidpdf(NaN, 6); y_nan2 = unidpdf(3, NaN);
comment: Sig: y = unidpdf(k, N). Discrete uniform PMF on {1..N}: 1/N if k in 1..N integer, else 0. N<=0 or non-integer N -> NaN. NaN N -> NaN. NaN k -> 0 (per MATLAB). tol=0 (integer-stable for discrete).
